sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 8–10) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 11 (bars 122–123).
sections.leads: From B minor to G major
